from collections import Counter
def find_divider(g):
    # maximal run of uniform rows whose color appears nowhere else in the grid
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    ur={i for i,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1}
    runs=[]; i=0
    while i<len(g):
        if i in ur:
            j=i
            while j+1 in ur: j+=1
            c=g[i][0]
            if cnt[c]==len(j-i+1)*len(g[0]): runs.append((i,j))
            i=j+1
        else: i+=1
    return runs

def overlap(g):
    runs=find_divider(g)

    d0,d1=runs[0]
    top=g[:d0]; bottom=g[d1+1:]
    off=len(bottom)-len(top)
    h,w=len(top),len(top[0])
    return [[2 if top[i][j] and bottom[i+off][j] else 0 for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
